# Stampfix

Stampfix is a digital loyalty card platform for small businesses. Merchants create a
digital stamp/punch card; their customers save it to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet —
no app to download — and collect stamps toward a reward.

## How it works
- A merchant sets up a loyalty card (stamps required, reward, branding) in about 30 seconds.
- Customers join by scanning a QR code, then add the card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.
- Staff give stamps by scanning the customer's card, or customers self-serve by scanning /
  tapping an NFC tag at the counter (verified by location).

Operated by 17999658 Canada Inc. GDPR-compliant; serves merchants in Canada and Germany.
